file_role: Derived selection and analysis summary; not a native AlphaFold 3 output

run_mode.multiple_sequence_alignments: Generated by the AlphaFold 3 data pipeline; pipeline output is retained.
run_mode.inference_time_structural_templates: Disabled by explicit empty template lists for both protein chains.

selection.rule: Maximum native AlphaFold 3 ranking_score before reference comparison.
selection.selected_file_note: The selected top-level CIF and sample CIF have identical coordinates and confidence data; only a model-group timestamp differs by one second.

native_af3_confidence.precision_note: The native summary stores ranking_score as 0.86; the precise selection score comes from the unmodified native ranking CSV.

conventions.mean_plddt: Mean across protein residues of each residue mean heavy-atom B-factor pLDDT.
conventions.iplddt: Mean residue pLDDT across the 20 chain-A and 21 chain-B interface residues defined by any heavy-atom pair within 4.5 angstrom.
conventions.pdockq: MolCompose canonical 8 angstrom C-beta contact definition, with C-alpha fallback for glycine.
conventions.pdockq2: 8 angstrom C-beta geometry with C-alpha fallback for glycine; mean residue heavy-atom pLDDT and A-to-B contact-pair PAE terms with d0 = 10 angstrom.
conventions.ipsae: d0res variant, PAE < 10 angstrom, maximum of the two directed chain-pair scores.
conventions.lis: Mean of both directed chain-pair LIS values; each averages (12 - PAE) / 12 over PAE < 12 angstrom.

derived_confidence.precision_note: The frozen pDockQ value and current validation differ only in the final floating-point digits; both are retained in their respective source records. The other listed derived confidence values match exactly.

interpretation: This sequence-based reconstruction uses automatically generated MSAs and learned structural priors, with inference-time templates disabled.
This is a single-case illustration of MolCompose analysis and reference comparison, not a structure-prediction benchmark.
correction_note: This summary replaces the earlier derived confidence summary with precise values and explicit aggregation conventions. All native AlphaFold 3 inputs, candidates, ranking, selected coordinates, confidence JSON files and output terms are preserved byte-for-byte.
licensing_note: AlphaFold 3 output and substantially derived material remain subject to the applicable third-party output terms; no package-level license overrides those terms.
